description: .NET version upgrade plan from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0

tasks.reason: .NET Framework 4.8 is a legacy framework with no cross-platform support and limited future investment from Microsoft. The user has explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. Upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS ensures long-term support, access to modern APIs, improved performance, and cross-platform compatibility.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the WebApp-Storage-DotNet project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10.0. This includes converting the legacy-style project file to SDK-style format, migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web) to ASP.NET Core MVC, updating all NuGet packages to net10.0-compatible versions (including Azure.Storage.Blobs and Azure.Core), replacing Web.config with appsettings.json, and replacing Global.asax with the modern Program.cs entry point.
